Norway raised its wealth tax rate by just 1 percentage point in 2022. The result: a wave of business owners left for Switzerland, tax revenue fell, and the firms they left behind declined. @veroderugy breaks down why wealth taxes don’t work.
ow.ly/G8We50ZnuPH

Link



All Suffer the Penalty of a Wealth Tax

Raise the price of an activity and people do less of it, restructure how they report it, or, if they can, leave the jurisdiction entirely.
